source.title: Machine Can Automatically Discover Parametric Functions to Model HEP Data

freeze_before_tuning: raw binned data bytes and source/version/license/acquisition provenance
train/validation/test split and record-level disjointness certificate
primary endpoint, coverage tolerance, proper score and multiplicity policy
shared seeds and hard resource ceilings
preregistration.cost_basis: one identical declared cost basis for every arm; include training plus inference

controls.purpose: positive control for recovering a known function or declared equivalence class
controls.acceptance: predeclare equivalence tolerance and report failures
predeclare null distribution and false-positive decision rule

controls.purpose: where scientifically appropriate, test recovery and uncertainty under blinded injected alternatives
controls.acceptance: freeze injection generator and parameters before running arms; report missed and false discoveries

acceptance_rules: Coverage tolerance and primary endpoint must be fixed before unblinding.
Assess coverage jointly with interval width and a proper predictive score; arbitrarily wide intervals cannot win.
Use preregistered paired analysis; marginal confidence intervals alone do not establish a winner.
A candidate with a failed physical/math constraint, unresolved counterexample, or false-discovery flag is not accepted as a physical law.
Hash declarations do not authenticate artifacts; verify exact bytes and actual split disjointness.
falsifiers: nominal intervals materially under-cover under the preregistered test
coverage depends on uninformatively wide intervals or degraded proper score
false positives or false discoveries worsen on null controls
claimed advantage vanishes on blind held-out spectra/conditions
claimed advantage depends on leakage, unequal resources, or post-hoc endpoint selection
stop_rules: Do not start a benchmark until code/data/license and byte-level provenance are verified.
Preserve all failed seeds, rejected functions, counterexamples and retries.
Do not infer a physical law, QPU advantage, energy saving or economic benefit from a fit result alone.
next_gate: Verify source/code/data/license bytes, then implement calibration metrics and tests against synthetic known-function and null controls before any real-data comparison.
